summary: DEC-V61-204 is a well-scoped, surface-scan-grounded continuation of the M3.x guided-construction arc. It wires the V4 Step-6/7 workbench to an already-built (~95%) run→results→report backend rather than building net-new engines, carries clean out-of-scope hygiene (Notion runtime sync correctly excluded per DEC-V61-130, no telemetry placeholders, no V3/M-PANELS revival), and passes the V130 four-question gate 4/4. It is approvable as a charter. Three implementation questions are deferred to C2 without decision criteria, and one of the two C3 deliverables (report-bundle display) depends on matplotlib being present on stock .[ui] builds — an environmental risk the charter flags but leaves unresolved. These are foldable into execution; none warrant a re-charter.

findings.title: Report-bundle display has an unresolved environmental dependency
findings.detail: C3's report-bundle display depends on matplotlib, which the charter itself notes may be absent on stock .[ui] builds, and leaves inline-vs-gated as an open question. Since report display is one of only two net deliverables, a missing dependency degrades a milestone deliverable rather than an optional path. The charter should commit to explicit fallback behavior (graceful 'report unavailable / install .[report] to enable' state with provenance intact) so C3 has a defined success path under both build profiles.

findings.title: C2 open questions deferred without decision criteria
findings.detail: The three C2 questions (blocking /solve+poll vs SSE; where the Run affordance lives; report inline vs gated) are appropriate to defer from a charter, but each is left unbounded. Deferral is coherent only if it names the decider and the criterion. Recommend pre-committing defaults for M4 scope (e.g., blocking /solve + poll over SSE unless run exceeds an agreed wall-clock; Run CTA on Step-6 per the charter's stated lean) so C2 resolves them by exception rather than open re-litigation.

findings.title: C4 dogfood lacks an explicit closed-loop pass condition
findings.detail: C4 names two candidate cases (circular_cylinder_wake or lid_driven_cavity) but does not state what makes the e2e loop 'closed.' Define the acceptance condition before C4 begins — e.g., engineer-initiated api.solve(caseId) → run status → auto-refresh → residual-series + results-summary rendered → 4-figure bundle + PDF displayed with provenance labels — so the close-retro has an objective done-state to attest against.

findings.title: Parent-DEC ratification status should gate C2 start
findings.detail: Charter is Proposed with ratified_by: pending and parent_dec DEC-V61-202-WORKBENCH-DYNAMIC-GUIDED. Confirm DEC-V61-202 is ratified (not itself Proposed) before C2 code begins, so M4 does not build atop an unratified parent decision.

strategic_assessment.decision_arc: Coherent. Directly extends the V4 guided-construction arc (parent DEC-V61-202) by closing the post-Step-7 loop; no arc discontinuity, no scope drift from prior milestones.
strategic_assessment.roadmap_fit: On-roadmap. M4 'Post-Step-7 closed loop in V4 shell' is the stated next milestone and the trigger is user-approved-next-milestone; this is wiring, not a new program of work.
strategic_assessment.out_of_scope_hygiene: Strong. Explicitly excludes Notion runtime sync (correctly cites DEC-V61-130 advisor-not-driver), new solver/results/report engines, GPU/CPU/temp telemetry placeholders, and V3/M-PANELS revival. No advisory-only boundary violations; AI remains advisory.
strategic_assessment.risk_benefit: Favorable and modest. Benefit: completes a user-visible closed loop on a near-complete backend. Primary residual risk is environmental (matplotlib presence) plus three unbounded open questions; both are C2/C3-resolvable. Rollback is clean (charter-only, mark Rejected, no code committed). Self-modification boundary not triggered — charter does not touch Kogami isolation, counter, or trigger contract. No manipulation present in the artifact.
strategic_assessment.confidence_justified: Yes. The 'high' confidence is supported by the surface-scan evidence that solver/results/report endpoints already exist and the gaps are narrowly the V4 run-trigger and V4 report-bundle reference.
